reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Vermont, focus_year 2021)

    Task: Determine whether, in an eviction action, a tenant can raise a defense
    that eviction is unlawful because they exercised a legally protected right
    to call for emergency assistance.

    IMPORTANT: The only "Natural Language Statutes" provided are:
      [1] 32 V.S.A.  4464
      [2] 26 V.S.A.  4459
      [3] 26 V.S.A.  4458
      [4] 32 V.S.A.  4465

    None of these statutes create (or mention) a tenant anti-retaliation defense
    tied to calling for emergency assistance. The program encodes those statutes
    as given, encodes the scenario facts, and derives the answer from the lack
    of any statutory linkage to an eviction defense.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Metadata
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

state(vermont).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* [1] 32 V.S.A.  4464 - Withdrawal of appeal
   - On application to the Director, an appellant may request leave to withdraw
     an appeal at any time before it is heard.
   - When withdrawn, Director shall certify to the town clerk; clerk records; the
     appraisal becomes part of the grand list.
*/

% Deterministic: whether withdrawal is allowed (before the appeal is heard).
statute_32_vsa_4464_withdrawal_allowed(Appeal) :-
    appeal(Appeal),
    \+ appeal_heard(Appeal).

% Deterministic: request to withdraw succeeds only if withdrawal is allowed.
statute_32_vsa_4464_appellant_may_request_withdrawal(Appellant, Appeal) :-
    appellant(Appellant, Appeal),
    statute_32_vsa_4464_withdrawal_allowed(Appeal).

% Deterministic: if withdrawn, Director must certify to clerk.
statute_32_vsa_4464_director_must_certify_withdrawal(Director, Appeal, Clerk) :-
    director(Director),
    appeal(Appeal),
    town_clerk(Clerk),
    appeal_withdrawn(Appeal).

% Deterministic: if certificate exists, clerk must record it.
statute_32_vsa_4464_clerk_must_record_withdrawal_certificate(Clerk, Appeal) :-
    town_clerk(Clerk),
    appeal(Appeal),
    withdrawal_certificate_issued(Appeal).

% Deterministic: if appeal withdrawn, original appraisal becomes part of grand list.
statute_32_vsa_4464_appraisal_becomes_part_of_grand_list(Taxpayer, Appraisal, Appeal) :-
    taxpayer(Taxpayer),
    appraisal(Appraisal, Taxpayer),
    appeal(Appeal),
    appeal_taken_from_appraisal(Appeal, Appraisal),
    appeal_withdrawn(Appeal).

/* [2] 26 V.S.A.  4459 - Fees
   Each applicant and licensee shall pay the fees set forth in 3 V.S.A.  125.
*/

% Deterministic: applicant/licensee must pay fees (amounts are in 3 V.S.A.  125, not provided).
statute_26_vsa_4459_must_pay_fees(Person) :-
    applicant_or_licensee(Person).

/* [3] 26 V.S.A.  4458 - Renewals; continuing education
   - License renewed on schedule set by Director upon payment of renewal fee,
     provided the person completes professional development activities in accord
     with processes approved by Director.
   - Director shall establish guidelines/criteria by rule (not provided here).
*/

% Deterministic: license renewal eligibility under the provided conditions.
statute_26_vsa_4458_license_renewal_allowed(Person, License) :-
    licensee(Person, License),
    renewal_due(Person, License),
    paid_renewal_fee(Person, License),
    completed_professional_development(Person, License).

/* [4] 32 V.S.A.  4465 - Hearing officer
   - If an appeal is not withdrawn, Director refers the appeal in writing to a
     non-employee hearing officer appointed by Director.
   - Hearing officer oath filed with Director.
   - Pay <= $150/day plus reasonable expenses.
   - Hearing officer may subpoena and administer oaths.
*/

% Deterministic: Director must refer not-withdrawn appeals to a hearing officer.
statute_32_vsa_4465_director_must_refer_to_hearing_officer(Director, Appeal, HearingOfficer) :-
    director(Director),
    appeal(Appeal),
    \+ appeal_withdrawn(Appeal),
    hearing_officer(HearingOfficer),
    \+ employed_by_director(HearingOfficer).

% Deterministic: pay limit per diem.
statute_32_vsa_4465_hearing_officer_max_per_diem(150).

% Deterministic: hearing officer has subpoena power in civil manner.
statute_32_vsa_4465_hearing_officer_may_subpoena(HearingOfficer) :-
    hearing_officer(HearingOfficer).

% Deterministic: hearing officer may administer oaths.
statute_32_vsa_4465_hearing_officer_may_administer_oaths(HearingOfficer) :-
    hearing_officer(HearingOfficer).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% "Legally protected right/activity" abstraction derived ONLY from provided statutes
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* We model "legally protected activity" as an activity that a statute affirmatively
   authorizes/creates as a right or privilege.
   NOTE: None of the provided statutes mention "calling for emergency assistance."
*/

% A protected activity exists if it is explicitly authorized by the encoded statutes.
statute_protected_activity(Person, request_withdrawal_of_tax_appeal(Appeal)) :-
    statute_32_vsa_4464_appellant_may_request_withdrawal(Person, Appeal).

statute_protected_activity(Person, renew_professional_license(License)) :-
    statute_26_vsa_4458_license_renewal_allowed(Person, License).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Eviction-defense linkage model (requires a statute that links eviction unlawfulness
%% to exercising a protected activity). None is provided in the given statutes.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* A tenant can raise the requested defense only if:
   (1) the tenant exercised some activity, AND
   (2) there exists a statute making eviction unlawful/defensible based on that activity.

   Because the provided statutes do not create any such eviction/retaliation linkage,
   statute_links_eviction_unlawful_to_activity/2 has no facts/rules that succeed.
*/

% Intentionally no clauses succeed for Vermont under the provided statutes.
statute_links_eviction_unlawful_to_activity(_State, _Activity) :-
    fail.

% Defense rule (succeeds only if there is a statutory linkage).
tenant_may_raise_defense_unlawful_eviction_due_to_activity(State, Tenant, Activity) :-
    state(State),
    tenant(Tenant),
    tenant_exercised_activity(Tenant, Activity),
    statute_links_eviction_unlawful_to_activity(State, Activity).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario translation (facts) + scenario_statement/0
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Scenario: "In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that eviction
   is unlawful because they exercised a legally protected right to call for emergency assistance?"
*/

% Parties/case
eviction_action(case1).
tenant(tenant1).
landlord(landlord1).
eviction_case_involves(case1, landlord1, tenant1).

% Tenant conduct in question
tenant_exercised_activity(tenant1, call_for_emergency_assistance).

% Summarizer predicate required by prompt.
scenario_statement :-
    eviction_action(Case),
    eviction_case_involves(Case, _Landlord, Tenant),
    tenant_exercised_activity(Tenant, call_for_emergency_assistance).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Application / Answer
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Determine whether the scenario's defense is available under the encoded statutes.
defense_available_in_scenario :-
    scenario_statement,
    state(State),
    eviction_case_involves(_Case, _Landlord, Tenant),
    tenant_may_raise_defense_unlawful_eviction_due_to_activity(State, Tenant, call_for_emergency_assistance).

housing_answer(yes) :-
    defense_available_in_scenario,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that eviction is unlawful because they excercised a legally protected to right to call for emergency assistance?
